topic: Myth: My teen isn't the entrepreneurial type
caption:
Not every teen is a natural go-getter. And that's completely okay.

Most kids who start earning money just needed one small win to get moving.

HustleUp walks your teen through real side hustles, step by step, until something clicks.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us

copy.body: Most teens who earn their first $50 doing something simple — walking dogs, designing graphics, washing cars — didn't start confident. They started willing.
